identitySelection.scope: Source-only identity specialization; unknown runtime conditions retain all paths. Direct target identity writes/address escapes and uncertified target-passing calls before a read prevent selection. Native detours/global aliases remain outside capture coverage. Assumes captured Projectile.type/aiStyle at UpdatePosition entry; enclosing caller identity preservation is not proved.

identityAlternatives.scope: Alternative source clues, conditional on reaching the listed guard; not behavior of the captured entry identity. Early-return proof covers normal source control flow, not exceptions/detours. These are not selectable native-AI imports or guarantees of Author capability equivalence.
